document.title: ci: check C formatting of src/ and tests/
document.summary: A `c-format` CI job installs clang-format 21.1.8 from PyPI and runs `scripts/clang-format.sh check`.
document.why: #119 gated `tests/` with clang-format locally, but CI does not enforce it [retro item 5](source:s1).

sources.label: Claude session · Oct 27

sources.label: 8cb20a5 Remove clang-format from CI workflow
sources.gist: Dropped the CI step because clang-format was unavailable on the macOS runner.

groups.title: Pinned clang-format job
groups.why: CI lost its format step in [8cb20a5](source:s3) when clang-format was missing on the macOS runner.
groups.summary: The Ubuntu `c-format` job installs a pinned clang-format with `pipx` and runs the same script as the `fast` tier, whose not-found hint and `AGENTS.md` name that version.
lookFor: A local clang-format of another major (MacPorts or Homebrew upgrade) can pass locally and fail this job, or the reverse; `AGENTS.md` now says to match 21.1.8.

commits.subject: ci: check C formatting of src/ and tests/
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
#119 gated tests/ with clang-format locally, but CI dropped the check in 8cb20a5 when clang-format was missing on
the macOS runner. A small Ubuntu job installs a pinned clang-format from PyPI and runs scripts/clang-format.sh.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
